title: Cosmic Multi-Faced Oracle
description: A surreal line-art figure with multiple eyes and faces holds a large cosmic orb containing planets and radiating lines. The background features colorful paint splatters, a ringed planet, mountain peaks, dotted pathways, and geometric celestial patterns.
prompt: Surreal cosmic figure composed of black ink lines with multiple faces and eyes, holding a large spherical orb showing planets and radiating patterns, set against a vibrant watercolor splatter background in blue, pink, yellow and orange, with ringed planets, stylized mountains, dotted pathways and geometric celestial symbols floating throughout the composition
